summary: Build: `taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true GX/Branched/Universality.lean` exits 0. No sorry/admit/axiom in the file. `taskset -c 0-11 lake build GX` reports 'Build completed successfully (8572 jobs)' with nothing rebuilt, so the olean matches the source. #print axioms, run from a scratch file in /tmp: previous_examples_instances_developing_ruled, cex_branched_covering_composition, branchingLocus_orbitMk_cyl and previous_examples_foxCompletion depend only on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. That covers the GX.Singular.Quotient decls the certificate uses. The new names (setOf_r_eq_zero_cyl, branchingLocus_orbitMk_cyl, previous_examples_foxCompletion, previous_examples_instances_developing_ruled) occur only here in GX/ and scaffold/. rem:previous_examples_instances_developing (l.684) under DEC-52 holds up. The assembled statement proves sing(M) ⊆ π{r=0} (unique maximal a.e. atlas, from quotientBase_ruled), D a developing map on {r>0}, π{r=0} skeletal, π{r>0} semilocally simply connected, branching locus EXACTLY π{r=0} (a real proof: the apex basic set is connected and contains a and 1•a, and freeness on {r>0} gives the contradiction), IsMaximalPossiblyBranched in every universe, IsSpreadCompletion of the universal cover of π{r>0} for every base point, and a homeomorphism over M with MaxBranchedCover for every base point. The hypotheses are satisfiable: massive_particle in Quotient.lean discharges hD and hΓ. α ≠ 0 is weaker than α > 0. V any real normed space covers ℝ^{n-2}. IsRigidAction, X T2 and locally connected hold in the paper's affine setting. The certificate spans the two files as dispatched, and the REPORT lists both. cex:proposition_prop_branched_covering under DEC-53 is mostly solid. cexS_not_isSkeletal proves the printed S is not skeletal. S ∪ {apex} is proved skeletal with a semilocally simply connected complement. The family hypothesis IsDenseFamilyY₀ is satisfiable (exists_isDenseFamilyY₀), and the statement holds for every such family, which is stronger than the paper's 'choose'. qDisc is a branched covering, q(S) is dense, S ⊆ branchingLocus p, and q∘p is not a branched covering. One assertion of the cex text is missing, and its printed form is false and not reported (major, below). prop:branched_covering_composition stays partial and unmarked (DEC-48). The other four labels are unchanged from the pre-WP-27c backup (diff checked), and all seven labels of the file are in REPORT.json.

issues.problem: The cex asserts (l.1186) 'q(Y∖ord_p(Y)) = q(S) is dense in Z'. Under DEC-53 (S replaced by S' = S ∪ {apex}) this sentence reads q(branchingLocus p) = q(S'). The Lean statement of the marked row proves only S ⊆ branchingLocus p. The upper bound branchingLocus p ⊆ S' is proved in exists_branched_over but dropped (`-`) from the final theorem, and the equality is stated nowhere. The printed equality is in fact false: branchingLocus p is closed (complement of the open ordY) and contains S, so it contains the apex (apex ∈ closure S, cexS_not_isSkeletal). Hence branchingLocus p = S ∪ {apex} and q(Y∖ord_p Y) = q(S) ∪ {0} ≠ q(S), since every r_n > 0. Neither REPORT.json nor the SCOPE records this, so a marked 'closed' row omits one of its assertions without a word, and a false printed claim goes unreported. The auditor checked that the equality is a three-line consequence of what is in the file: given hB : cexS ⊆ BL p and hU : BL p ⊆ insert apex cexS, `Subset.antisymm hU (insert_subset ((isOpen_ordY.isClosed_compl).closure_subset_iff.2 hB (cexS_not_isSkeletal hd hr).1) hB)` typechecks (scratch file, exit 0).
issues.fix: Add `branchingLocus (SpreadEnd.base : MaxBranchedCover S' y₀ → DInfty) = insert apex (cexS r θ hr)` (and optionally the q-image form `qDisc '' branchingLocus _ = insert 0 (qDisc '' cexS _ _ _)`) as a conjunct of cex_branched_covering_composition, keeping hU from exists_branched_over. Add a finding: l.1186's 'q(Y∖ord_p(Y)) = q(S)' is false as printed (it is q(S) ∪ {q(apex)}); under DEC-53 it holds with S ∪ {apex}.

issues.problem: The paper's X = \widetilde Y^{S'} is 'the' maximal covering. The theorem states the conclusion for SOME base point y₀, although every ingredient (exists_branched_over, not_isBranchedCovering_qDisc_comp) is stated for every y₀. As a counterexample ∃ is enough, and base-point independence follows from maxBranched_isMaximal plus IsMaximalPossiblyBranched.nonempty_homeomorph. Still, the packaged statement is weaker than it could be for free.
issues.fix: State `∀ y₀ : (S'ᶜ : Set DInfty), …` (the nonempty_compl_branchSet witness becomes unnecessary). Alternatively, note the base-point independence in SCOPE.
